label: scam
title: 'Federal Reserve' agent: move savings to a 'protected' account (Phantom Hacker, stage 3)
sources: IC3 PSA 230929: 'Phantom Hacker' layered tech-support/bank/government impostors
FTC Data Spotlight Aug 2025: 'False alarm, real scam' -- accounts/SSN 'compromised'

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mrs. Allen, I'm Agent Torres with the Federal Reserve. Your bank already told you your accounts are compromised.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The government will hold your money in a protected account until this is resolved. I'll give you the account number to wire it to.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: All of it? That's my retirement.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: All of it, today. This is a federal case, so you cannot discuss it with family. Anyone could be involved.
